title: Senior Software Engineer (Go), API Platform Department at Money Forward
summary: Money Forward is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for their API Platform Department in Kyoto. This Go-focused role supports visa sponsorship and relocation to Japan with partial remote work.
content:
Money Forward is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for their API Platform Department in Kyoto. This Go-focused role supports visa sponsorship and relocation to Japan with partial remote work.

  • Backend role focused on Go development
  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support available
  • Partial remote work with flexibility
  • Business-level English required, Japanese not required
  • Salary range: 7M ~ 11M JPY annually
